title: Ultralight CMS Runtime Notes
source: Consolidated runtime and logic commentary from the CW/UltralightCMS project conversations.

points: A Data Property defines a typed runtime slot contract; runtime state lives in an execution context and does not mutate the canonical .cw artifact.
value:null means UNBOUND. UNBOUND is not schema-invalid and does not satisfy ready conditions.
READY means non-null and schema-valid when schema_ref exists.
INVALID means a non-null candidate violates its Schema or another declared constraint.
Package validity is not runtime READY state.
Function boundaries are Event-mediated; function_call Links and logic op=call are forbidden.
One emitted Event occurrence preserves the current execution context.
event_condition with condition_mode=ready guards an Event occurrence against the actual Data slot.
An emitted Event with unsatisfied guards remains pending and dispatches exactly once when all guards become satisfied.
No parallel *_READY Data truth is used.
Function.input_refs contains canonical Properties actually read by the modeled Function logic.
Function.output_refs contains canonical Properties actually written or produced by the modeled Function logic.
Execution-context Data visible around a Function is not automatically a Function input.
FUNCTION_OPEN_PAGE is intentionally a pure causal relay with empty input_refs and output_refs.
Page routing identity is PageContent.id; title is presentation only.
The content collection is a list of records containing required id, title and body.
id values are unique and a READY content collection contains exactly one item with id=index.
Resolution first looks up the requested page_id and falls back to id=index on zero matches.
The fallback key index is a mechanism constant, while its title may be Home, Etusivu or any other presentation text.
If the required index invariant is nevertheless violated at execution time, the Function fails with INVALID_CONTENT_SOURCE rather than writing null forward.
lookup executes only against a READY collection; UNBOUND or INVALID source is INVALID execution rather than a null lookup result.
Zero matches in a READY collection returns null; more than one match is INVALID.
The style slot is a raw string contract because the physical Asset is CSS; no artificial {css:...} wrapper is introduced.
Compose writes a structured rendered-document draft and finalize produces the published document.
The final publish Effect replaces the index document target using explicit event_effect and effect_target Links.
